title: Kim Jong Un to Henry VIII: how?
description: A border handshake, a Vatican visit, 50 popes and a 1521 miniature link Kim Jong Un to Henry VIII.
hook: What links Kim Jong Un to Henry VIII?
fun_fact: In 1521 Pope Leo X named Henry VIII "Defender of the Faith", and British monarchs still carry the title, even though Henry later broke with Rome.
research_note: The old route scrolled a short line of English monarchs; Henry VIII now comes in through a British Library miniature of about 1521 that shows him with Pope Leo X, and the line of popes runs from Leo to Pope Francis, who met Trump in 2017.

links.line: In 1513, 49 popes before Francis, Leo X was elected pope.
And around 1521, an artist painted Leo X with King Henry VIII.
